purpose: Falsifiable audit of seller-role voice colliding with buyer/demand lexical heuristics; review-only, not production classification.

preregistration.prior_observations_used_for_rule_design: PR234–239 public aggregate reports and evidence_integrity.py guard code; no individual real labels

limitations: Author-labelled synthetic fixtures test behavior, not real-world accuracy or commercial truth.
March 2026 public HN is a fresh untouched window for THIS rule, but shares provider and classifier with earlier experiments; not independent cross-source validation.
An explicit seller-role cue does not prove a message has no buyer-side need; mixed cases remain accepted and flagged for review.
Buyer/seller risk flags are an annotation only; they cannot prevent commercial evidence, change accepted threads, or mutate the student.
Live risk counts do not provide false-positive rates because source cases are not double blind human-labelled.
Human independent validation and a different source are still blocked. No commercial promotion.
